_comment: Which resolved packages ship inside Overhear.app, and so need their license
text carried with the binary. SwiftPM's dependency graph is package-level, not
target-level, so it cannot tell a package we link against from one only a
sibling target or a build plugin uses — that judgement lives here.
The GenerateAcknowledgements plugin reconciles this file against the resolved
graph on every build and fails with a diagnostic if the two disagree, so a new
or dropped dependency cannot slip through unclassified.

swift-collections.name: swift-collections
swift-collections.note: Apache-2.0 with the Runtime Library Exception, which waives §4 attribution for code embedded by compilation. Listed anyway: harmless, and simpler than carving it out.

swift-argument-parser.name: swift-argument-parser
swift-argument-parser.note: Only WhisperKitCLI depends on it, and we don't build that target — nothing from it lands in the app.

swiftlintplugins.name: SwiftLintPlugins
swiftlintplugins.note: A build-time command plugin. Runs on our source, never links into the binary.
